## 2. Executive Summary
Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building and improving products for startups and international companies. Works across backend development, cloud infrastructure, product analytics, and internal tools, with a focus on solving real business problems and making systems and processes work better.

Works closely with product, operations, support, and finance to understand their needs and turn ideas into production-ready features. Handles the process end to end, from discussions with stakeholders and technical design to implementation, database migrations, deployment, and post-release monitoring across backend services, mobile features, and internal tooling.

Beyond feature development, has contributed to migrating manual processes toward AI-assisted workflows and improving/maintaining the internal tools the team relies on—including MCP (Model Context Protocol) internal tooling to connect with preferred LLMs, focused plugins and skills for each internal team area, and prompting rules control with Cloudflare AI Gateway. Uses Datadog to monitor services, configure alerts, and investigate production issues, CleverTap to track product events and business metrics, and Metabase to analyze data and support product decisions.
